name: ask-user
title: Ask the user
description: ask_user is a deferred tool (no execute): the model asks one nonblank question up to 2000 characters and the turn waits. The owner answers with core answer({ threadId, toolCallId, text }); the model sees the text. No item tables; native pending-call state and core hold it.
docs: Use a TypeScript host with tsx: true in components.json before installing. Register createAskUserTool() on an agevex Agent with host authorize/authorizeExecution. Requires the host's existing agevex package. Answer with core answer, never by saving a native tool result directly. See /docs/tools/ask-user.
